# MOST sustained-pitch controller inputs

These MATLAB data files were generated by WEC-Sim Applications commit
`d53d4d4c9eda2581f04204f5d394a6ef84bb099e` with WEC-Sim core commit
`0753b2e47f2457c078751dcfe5d251d1767b80ab` under R2025b. They came
from the passing 30 s source run [39100233089](https://github.com/cmudrc/wec-sim-python/actions/runs/39100233089)
(artifact `matlab-most-constant-wind-sustained-pitch`).

The source steady-state optimization changes its output slightly between CI
runs with the same pinned code and wave input. One run produced 20 baseline
torque breakpoints and another produced 19; the latter missed the unchanged
0.0003 rad controller-replay gate. The workflow pins only these generated
controller inputs for the sustained-pitch comparison. It still regenerates
hydrodynamic data and runs the coupled WEC-Sim model and Python comparison.

Local R2025b runs using these inputs passed the unchanged 30 s gate with
either CI-generated HDF5 variant from runs 39100233089 and 39101328311.
